### Ballina Arts Centre June Meetup 09.06.23 9pm until Midnight

Summer is almost here and to celebrate the <del>arrival of the one or two days where it might hit 20</del> seasonal opening of the Ballina Riviera, we thought it was about time to have our second NCF social!

What is THENCF? It's a place where people who are into the arts can hang out at night and get to know each other. If you want to find out more about the long term goals of the collective, check out out the [proposal](https://thencf.art/proposal.html).

We were hoping this one would be for our first 'home' event but alas it was not to be this time. Suffice to say work is continuing to secure our own space.

In the meantime Paul Cunningham has once again kindly offered to host us in the Arts Centre. To quote Paul, "it will be an open decks affair again so anyone is free to bring records if they want to play for a while" - DJs of THENCF unite and take over.

The bar will be open upstairs - Beer, wine, cocktails - so when you come in head straight up there.

Please spread the word, see you all on the 9th!

Love, th'NCF.

[Ballina Arts Centre info](https://ballinaartscentre.com/contact/)
